faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How fast can it be ready?
faq.a1: In most cases, 1 to 2 weeks from briefing to live — landing pages are focused projects. If your campaign has a launch date, tell us and we'll work backwards from it.
faq.q2: I already have a website. Do I really need a landing page?
faq.a2: If you buy traffic, yes. Your homepage has ten possible paths; a landing page has one. Sending paid traffic to your homepage is paying for visitors and handing them a maze.
faq.q3: Do you also manage the ad campaigns?
faq.a3: Our focus is the page and the tracking. We work side by side with whoever runs your campaigns — your team or an agency — and deliver everything ready to measure: pixel, events and UTMs tuned.
faq.q4: What do you need from me to start?
faq.a4: A clear offer and 30 minutes of conversation. If you already have the ad (or the idea for it), even better — we design the page from the promise you're about to make.
faq.q5: What about GDPR? Is the tracking legal?
faq.a5: Yes — nothing fires without consent. A cookie banner with a real gate: if the visitor declines, the pixel doesn't start. You measure what you're allowed to, with a clear conscience.
faq.q6: Can I connect the landing to my CRM?
faq.a6: Yes — to your current CRM or to Branct CRM. With ours, the lead arrives with the source campaign identified and the AI can reply on WhatsApp within seconds, 24/7.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does a premium site take?
faq.a1: It depends on scope, but most projects go from briefing to live in 3 to 6 weeks. The proposal includes a timeline with concrete dates — and we keep it.
faq.a2: Each proposal is tailored to scope: number of pages, languages, integrations. Send us your goal and within 48h you have a fixed price — no surprises mid-project.
faq.q3: I already have a site. Is it worth redoing?
faq.a3: First we run a free diagnosis of your current site: speed, SEO and conversion. If it's good, we tell you so — and you know where you stand. If it isn't, we show you exactly what it's costing you in customers.
faq.a4: The technical SEO base (structure, schema.org, sitemap, performance) is included in every project — it's how we build, not an add-on. Ongoing content strategy is a separate service.
faq.q5: After launch, am I on my own?
faq.a5: No. Every project includes post-launch support, and you can add continuous evolution: monitoring, reports and monthly improvements driven by your visitors' real data.
faq.q6: Does the site connect to a CRM?
faq.a6: Yes — forms can connect to your current CRM or to Branct CRM, our platform with AI that answers your leads on WhatsApp 24/7. Site and CRM from the same house means zero leads lost between systems.
